mediaPolicy: Code-native vector artwork only. No archival image is reproduced or implied.

scenes.title: A light for remembrance
scenes.motif: Rising light and seven quiet rays
scenes.interpretation: Abstract light marks remembrance and the beginning of a careful journey.

scenes.title: Words, earth and industry
scenes.motif: Written lines orbit an abstract spiral beside a headgear motif
scenes.interpretation: The spiral and structure are symbolic; they do not reproduce mine shape, scale or engineering.

scenes.title: Lines from a junction
scenes.motif: Rail lines converge and a letter travels outward
scenes.interpretation: Converging paths connect the chapter's documented letter with travel; no operational railway claim is made.

scenes.title: Reading the layers
scenes.motif: Karoo strata reveal an abstract fossil trace
scenes.interpretation: Layer and fossil forms evoke geology and palaeontology; they do not identify a species or what is visible from the train.

scenes.title: Uses across a lifetime
scenes.motif: A railway-era streetscape draws in as lamps illuminate
scenes.interpretation: A stylised streetscape connects rail, writing and changing building uses; it is not an architectural reconstruction.

scenes.title: A route of public memory
scenes.interpretation: The weave represents connected public memory and does not map private homes or exact heritage-route geometry.

scenes.title: Streets remembered
scenes.motif: A street grid appears, recedes and returns in fragments
scenes.interpretation: The changing grid responds to the museum exhibition title Streets: Retracing District Six; it does not reconstruct erased buildings or residents' testimony.
